title: NAVIGATING CRUCIAL CONVERSATIONS IN THE WORKPLACE
description: Examines how a culture of effective dialogue fosters employee engagement.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: BA 252 or 252H.
A minimum grade of C- is required in BA 252 and BA 252H.

Enrollment is limited to students with a program in:

  • Supply Chain & Logistics Mgmt (075)
  • Business Administration (181)
  • Finance (182)
  • Business Information Systems (183)
  • Accountancy (641)
  • Marketing (799)
  • Business Analytics (899)
  • Organizational Leadership (A018)
  • Innovation & Entrepreneurship (A039)
  • Sports Business (A050)
books_html: No-cost: Course utilizes open educational resources, materials available through the library, or does not require any purchased materials.
meeting_html: R 1pm-1:50pm in MLM 236 - Milam Hall 236 (9/23 to 12/4)
